content: Evolution API v2 webhooks: configurable globally or per instance (POST /webhook/set/{instance} or webhook object inside /instance/create with url, byEvents, base64, events[]). Event names include APPLICATION_STARTUP, QRCODE_UPDATED, CONNECTION_UPDATE, SEND_MESSAGE, MESSAGES_UPSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, GROUPS_UPSERT, GROUP_UPDATE, CONTACTS_*, CHATS_*, CALL. byEvents=true appends the lowercased/underscored event name to the webhook path (e.g. /webhook/evolution/qrcode-updated). Payload envelope carries event, instance, data, sender, server_url, apikey, date_time. Per-instance webhooks preferred for control. QRCODE_UPDATED carries the new base64 QR; CONNECTION_UPDATE carries state open/close/connecting.
